newsitem.title: NEPAL: Eighteen killed as Nepal bus plunges into river.
newsitem.headline: Eighteen killed as Nepal bus plunges into river.

text.p: At least 18 people, including two women and two children, were killed when a bus plunged into a river some 160 km (100 miles) west of the Nepali capital of Kathmandu, police said on Tuesday.
The accident occured when the bus failed to negotiate a steep climb and fell about 200 feet (60 metres) at Paundi in Lamjung district, they said.
